title: How a pendulum's length sets its period

params.text: A quarter of the length gives half the period, and four times the length gives twice the period: the period grows with the square root of the length. The mass of the bob does not change it.

experiments.purpose: Does four times the length make the swing four times slower?
contrasts: 4 m: twice the 1 m period, not four times

experiments.purpose: Does a heavier bob swing faster or slower?
contrasts: the period readout and plot point stay put while the bob grows
